title: Land the [A<n>]-marked acceptance and evidence binding for gvc, xte and wne (klq's unmet item)
body: klq's acceptance requires xte, wne and gvc to carry marked acceptance. At HEAD all three are prose, and the operator finding (klq, high) is still proposed. Until they are marked, acceptance.Decide refuses on every real epic including gvc itself, so no finding is ever absorbed outside fixtures. This needs a tracker write plus an [evidence.acceptance] binding in .tick/runners.toml, which only a person can land.
